title: BLE iBeacon and Flutter: advertising and live GATT data

spans.text: BLE advertising can announce proximity; a GATT connection can share live readings with a phone. They are different mechanisms.

iBeacon is an Apple-defined BLE advertising frame containing a UUID, major/minor values, and calibrated Tx power. It supports approximate proximity, not precise distance: RSSI varies with walls, orientation, and radio conditions. Advertising is connectionless and is not a suitable stream for live sensor values. A GATT server exposes services/characteristics; a Flutter BLE central connects, enables notifications, and receives each update. Advertising needs no connection; GATT notifications do.

The ESP32 sketch advertises an iBeacon frame using the Arduino-ESP32 BLE API. The Flutter examples scan manufacturer data with
and subscribe to a GATT notification. Configure platform Bluetooth permissions and use the exact UUIDs from your firmware.

spans.title: Important safety and compatibility note
spans.text: `flutter_blue_plus` may require a commercial license; verify its current terms before shipping a for-profit app. Cancel stream subscriptions when the screen closes and handle disconnects. Do not use beacons for covert tracking.
